review: 702.117a-1: opponent_spell_cast had B cast Shock in A's upkeep although the setup starts in main1; moved B's Shock into A's main1 (B casts after A passes with an empty stack). Base decisions now include the pass that lets Goblin Freerunner resolve, which its expected reports.

scenarios.title: A surge spell can be cast for its surge cost only after the caster has cast another spell this turn

setup.notes: Goblin Freerunner costs {3}{R} and has surge {1}{R}. A has three Mountains, so the full cost {3}{R} is out of reach and only the surge cost {1}{R} is affordable (after paying {R} for Shock). Nothing has been cast this turn.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting B, tapping one Mountain; both players pass and Shock resolves.
A then casts Goblin Freerunner for its surge cost {1}{R}, tapping the other two Mountains; the engine's verdict on that cast is read, then both players pass and it resolves if it was cast.

variants.label: own_spell_cast
variants.expected: Casting Goblin Freerunner for its surge cost is legal; the cost after adjustment is {1}{R}. Shock deals 2 damage to B (life 18) and Goblin Freerunner resolves onto the battlefield.

variants.label: no_spell_cast
variants.delta: A casts no spell before Goblin Freerunner; Shock stays in A's hand.
variants.expected: Casting Goblin Freerunner is illegal: the surge cost is not available, the cost stays {3}{R} and A has only three Mountains.

variants.label: opponent_spell_cast
variants.delta: A casts no spell before Goblin Freerunner; instead, after A passes priority in main1 with an empty stack, B casts Shock targeting A, it resolves and A receives priority again in main1.
variants.expected: Casting Goblin Freerunner is illegal: a spell cast by an opponent does not enable surge, the cost stays {3}{R} and A has only three Mountains. A's life is 18.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge checks surge through a count of spells cast this turn by the player (and teammates); an opponent's spell must not count.
